## A projection is a perpendicular shadow {#iv7-shadow .vector-lesson .projection-lesson }

```{=html}
<div class="pr-interactive" data-projection="interactive"></div>
```


<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Section 7 · p. 54</div>

::: notes
Change angle and length. Reveal the perpendicular drop, then the parallel projection, then the remaining component using the three independent buttons. The scalar result appears with the projection. Compare 60°,90°,120°,0°,180°; Reset restores 60°, length 4 and all three hidden. Scalar projection is a signed amount along b, not always a length. The chosen direction b is horizontal here; its drawn length does not affect the projection. The blue original vector is the sum of the teal parallel part and orange perpendicular part. No 3D interaction.
:::
